_about: The `stuck` section of a fastbridge-lp config, read by lib/stuck-pricing.mjs (stuck TAC bounty, entry C). On its own it changes nothing: a daemon takes stuck TAC at these prices only once it loads the rule. Amounts are base units (1 TAC = 1e8), rates are bps. The defaults in the code are these values; a section that names only what it changes is enough.
